title: 未命名0085未命名0084
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰微微颔首，坦然应下：“先祖重托，我铭记于心，必护朱雀道统不灭，守圣殿万古安宁。”
此言落地，堂堂正正，无愧于心。
朱雀残魂托付他的，从来不止是至宝与传承，更是炎曦的安稳、朱雀道统的延续。
他既许下承诺，便会终身践行。
南宫三老闻言，神色稍稍缓和，心中最后一丝颜面得以保全。
南宫渊深深看了叶辰一眼，缓缓拱手：“既然小友已然得全机缘，感悟传承，那七层禁地风波，便就此落幕。我等三人，就此退去，不扰小友清修。”
说完，他转身抬手，对着另外两位长老示意。
三人不再停留，身姿微动，周身收敛所有气息威压，褪去所有不甘戾气，化作三道略显萧瑟的苍老流光，缓缓朝着七层结界出口掠去。
背影佝偻落寞，不复之前强势霸道，只剩无尽的失意与憋屈。
三千年执念，一朝成空，万古苦修，为人作嫁。
这一战，他们未曾落败，却输得彻彻底底，输得一无所有。
看着三道苍老身影渐渐远去，消失在结界出口，七层圣殿终于彻底恢复了真正的宁静。
再无威压制衡，再无外人窥探，再无纷争纠葛。
偌大的神圣空间之中，唯有叶辰一人伫立，手握绝世内丹，身负上古传承，心藏朱雀神卵。
晚风透过结界缝隙轻轻拂入，吹动他一身衣袍猎猎作响，少年身姿孤绝挺拔，立于万古圣殿中央，身负漫天道韵，眼藏山河星河，风华绝代，举世无双。
叶辰缓缓低头，看向掌心的古朴木盒。
盒身古朴厚重，镌刻着万古朱雀纹路，每一道纹路都流淌着淡淡的神圣气息，承载着上古神兽的毕生修为与无尽母爱。
他没有急于开启炼化，而是指尖轻轻抚过盒身纹路，心神肃穆，轻声低语：“前辈放心，我必守诺一生，护炎曦无忧，兴朱雀道统，不负传承，不负所托。”
一语落毕，响彻心间，金石为证，天地为鉴。
话音落下，叶辰抬手结出一道温和的护道印诀，将整只木盒稳稳护住，隔绝一切外界干扰。

随后他缓步走到圣殿中央的白玉石台上，缓缓盘膝端坐，身姿端正，心神澄澈，开启了静坐调息。
刚刚承袭无上传承，海量的道则奥义涌入识海，尚且需要时间彻底消化融汇，沉淀底蕴，稳固道基。
与此同时，他也要借助七层圣殿残留的上古道韵，温养周身经脉，契合万火道则，让混沌道体与朱雀本源彻底相融，将此番机缘的收益压榨到极致。
随着他静心入定，整片七层圣殿的残存灵气、神火余温、万古道韵，尽数如同百川归海，源源不断朝着他的身躯汇聚而来，环绕周身，流转不息。
赤金色的神火微光萦绕在他周身，与混沌黑白气韵交织相融，形成一圈独一无二的双色道韵光环，神圣而玄奥，霸道而温润。
时间缓缓流逝，一息万变，寸寸沉淀。
圣殿之外，六层、五层乃至整座朱雀圣殿的修士，皆能隐约感知到七层禁地传来的浩瀚道韵波动，神圣磅礴，绵延不绝，却无人胆敢窥探半分。
南宫三老退出七层结界之后，并未远去，而是伫立在六层圣殿的云海之上，遥遥望着七层禁地的方向，面色阴沉，久久不语。
风吹动三人的白发黑袍，萧瑟孤寂，满心沉郁。
良久，脾气最为急躁的南宫鹤终于忍不住低声开口，语气满是不甘与戾气：“师兄，难道我们就真的就此作罢？三千年苦熬，最后什么都没得到，反而白白成全了一个外来小辈，我实在咽不下这口气！”
“先祖残魂已然消散，所谓的禁令，只是烙印在血脉之中的约束，不让我们觊觎圣殿至宝而已，并未禁止我们寻仇！”
南宫玄眼底寒光闪烁，阴恻恻开口：“没错！至宝归他，传承归他，我们无可奈何，可今日之辱，今日之憾，绝不能就这么算了。此子横空出世，夺我族万古机缘，断我等生路，便是我南宫古族不共戴天的敌人！”
“今日我们受制于神威，只能隐忍，可来日他踏出朱雀圣殿，进入朱雀域俗世，我有的是办法让他付出代价！”
两人话语之中，杀心渐显，戾气丛生。
唯有为首的南宫渊，依旧沉默伫立，苍老的眼眸遥遥望着七层方向，神色深沉，无人看透心思。
许久，他才缓缓开口，声音低沉凝重：“急不得。”
“此子心性沉稳，定力超凡，能在绝境之中护住神卵，得先祖极致认可，绝非寻常天骄可比。他如今手握朱雀本源内丹，身负三大上古神通，底蕴暴涨，真实战力深不可测。”
“我等刚刚错失机缘，心境大乱，修为浮动，此刻贸然动手，非但无法报仇，反而大概率自取其辱，暴露戾气，落人口实。”
content_en:
Ye Chen nodded slightly and responded calmly: "I will bear in mind the great trust of my ancestors. I will protect the immortality of the Suzaku Taoist lineage and safeguard the eternal peace of the temple."
These words are true to the truth, and they are upright and worthy of the heart.
What the remnant soul of Suzaku entrusted to him was never only the treasure and inheritance, but also the stability of Yanxi and the continuation of Suzaku's orthodoxy.
Once he makes a promise, he will keep it throughout his life.
When Nangong Sanlao heard this, his expression softened slightly, and the last bit of dignity in his heart was saved.
Nangong Yuan took a deep look at Ye Chen and slowly handed over his hands: "Now that I have had the opportunity to understand the inheritance, the storm in the seventh-level forbidden land has come to an end. The three of us will leave here and not disturb my cultivation."
After speaking, he turned around and raised his hand to signal to the other two elders.
The three of them no longer stayed, and their postures moved slightly. All the aura and coercion around their bodies converged, and all the unwillingness and hostility faded away. They turned into three slightly desolate old streams of light, slowly moving towards the exit of the seventh-layer barrier.
His back was hunched and lonely, no longer as strong and domineering as before, only filled with endless frustration and aggrievedness.
Three thousand years of obsession came to nothing in one day, and I practiced hard for eternity to get married.
In this battle, they were not defeated, but they lost completely and lost everything.
Watching the three old figures gradually move away and disappear at the exit of the barrier, the seven-story temple finally regained its true tranquility.
There is no more coercion, no more prying eyes, no more disputes.
In the huge sacred space, only Ye Chen stood alone, holding the peerless inner elixir in his hand, carrying the ancient inheritance, and hiding the Suzaku Divine Egg in his heart.
The evening breeze gently blew in through the gaps in the barrier, making his robes make a hunting sound. The young man stood alone and tall in the center of the eternal temple.
Ye Chen slowly lowered his head and looked at the simple wooden box in his palm.
The body of the box is simple and heavy, engraved with the eternal suzaku pattern. Each pattern flows with a faint sacred breath, carrying the life-long cultivation and endless maternal love of the ancient mythical beast.
He did not rush to start refining, but gently stroked the lines on the box with his fingertips, and whispered softly with a solemn heart: "Senior, don't worry, I will keep my promise for the rest of my life, protect the Yanxi without worries, promote the Suzaku Taoism, live up to the inheritance, and live up to the trust."
When the words are finished, they resound in the heart, with gold and stone as evidence, and heaven and earth as a mirror.
After finishing his words, Ye Chen raised his hand to form a gentle protective seal, firmly protecting the entire wooden box and blocking out all external interference.
Then he walked slowly to the white jade platform in the center of the temple, slowly sat cross-legged, with an upright posture and a clear mind, and started meditation and breathing.
Having just inherited the supreme inheritance, a large amount of Tao principles and mysteries have poured into the sea of ​​consciousness. It still takes time to completely digest and integrate them, accumulate the foundation, and stabilize the Tao foundation.
At the same time, he will also use the remaining ancient Tao charm of the seven-story temple to warm the meridians throughout his body, conform to the principles of Wanhuo Tao, and completely integrate the Chaos Tao body with the origin of Suzaku, so as to squeeze the benefits of this opportunity to the extreme.
As he meditated and fell into concentration, the remaining spiritual energy, the remaining warmth of the divine fire, and the eternal Taoist charm of the entire seven-story temple were all like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, continuously converging towards his body, surrounding him, and flowing endlessly.
The shimmer of red-gold divine fire lingered around him, intertwined with the chaotic black and white aura, forming a unique two-color halo of Tao aura, which was sacred and mysterious, domineering and gentle.
Time passes slowly, changing every breath and settling every inch.
Outside the temple, the monks on the sixth floor, fifth floor, and even the entire Suzaku Temple can vaguely sense the vast fluctuations of Taoism coming from the seventh-floor forbidden area. It is sacred, majestic, and endless, but no one dares to pry into it.
After Nangong Sanlao exited the seventh-level enchantment, he did not go far away. Instead, he stood on the sea of ​​clouds in the sixth-level temple, looking far away in the direction of the seventh-level forbidden land, with a gloomy face and silence for a long time.
The wind blew the white hair and black robes of the three people, making them feel desolate and lonely, and their hearts were filled with depression.
For a long time, Nangong He, who had the most irritable temper, finally couldn't help but speak in a low voice, his tone full ofReluctant and angry: "Senior brother, are we really going to give up here? After three thousand years of hard work, I got nothing in the end. Instead, I succeeded to a foreign junior in vain. I really can't swallow this breath!"
"The remnant souls of our ancestors have dissipated. The so-called prohibition is just a restriction imprinted in the blood. It only prevents us from coveting the treasure of the temple. It does not prohibit us from seeking revenge!"
Nangong Xuan's eyes flashed with cold light, and he spoke sadly: "That's right! The treasure belongs to him, and the inheritance belongs to him. We can't do anything about it, but today's humiliation and today's regret must not be forgotten like this. This son came out of the sky, took away our clan's eternal opportunity, and cut off our livelihood. He is the sworn enemy of our ancient Nangong clan!"
"Today we are controlled by the divine power and can only endure it. But in the future, when he steps out of the Suzaku Temple and enters the Suzaku Realm, I have many ways to make him pay the price!"
In the words of the two people, murderous intentions gradually emerged, and hostility abounded.
Only the leader, Nangong Yuan, still stood silently, his old eyes looking far away in the direction of the seventh floor, his expression deep, and no one could read his thoughts.
After a long time, he spoke slowly, his voice low and solemn: "There's no rush."
"This son has a calm mind and extraordinary concentration. He is able to protect the divine eggs in desperate situations. He is highly recognized by his ancestors. He is no ordinary genius. He now holds the original inner elixir of Suzaku and possesses three ancient magical powers. His foundation has skyrocketed, and his true combat power is unfathomable."
"I just missed the opportunity, my mind is in chaos, and my cultivation level is fluctuating. If we act rashly now, not only will we not be able to take revenge, but we will most likely humiliate ourselves, expose our hostility, and live up to our words."
